name: Krabi Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 3,000 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration 08:30–16:30 local, and on demand

slots.v: Level 2 (schedule facilitated) airport: schedules facilitated by the Department of Airports (DOA); non-scheduled flights must obtain slots
slots.quote: KBV/VTSG | Krabi/Krabi Airport | Facilitation | DOA; Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

ppr.v: non-scheduled flights need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead
ppr.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance
